description: The pie chart visually represents the distribution of video content categories used in the study “Enhancing Multimodal LLM for Detailed and Accurate Video Captioning using Multi-Round Preference Optimization.” It is divided into 14 distinct segments, each labeled with a content category and its corresponding percentage. The largest segment is “People Blogs” at 17.2%, followed by “Education” at 13.9%, and “Howto Style” at 9.7%. Other notable segments include “Sports” (7.7%), “Film Animation” (4.6%), and “Gaming” (6.4%). Smaller categories such as “Music” (2.3%), “Autos Vehicles” (4.8%), “Pets Animals” (3.9%), “News Politics” (4.3%), “Science Technology” (6.4%), “Comedy” (5.6%), and “Travel Events” (4.6%) make up the remainder. Each slice is color-coded and labeled with its percentage, and the chart includes a legend-like gray bar on the left, though it is unlabeled. The segments are arranged in a clockwise order starting from the top-right, with no apparent hierarchical or thematic grouping beyond size. The chart provides a clear proportional breakdown of the dataset’s categorical composition, which likely informs the training or evaluation of the multimodal LLM described in the paper.
